message.reasoning_content:
I'm president (influence 3). Next market round 6: last round. Produce gives 2 goods to sell at price ~ sold_counter currently 5... round 5 sold 2 more? sell_credit units 2 already done (sold counter 5 includes that). Price at counter 5 = 5+? price index 5 → 5 alashi? Prices [12,10,9,8,7,6,...] index 5 = 6 alashi. Selling 2 more units would push price down. Producing 2 goods sold at 6 and 5 = 11 alashi cash (cash not devalued? round 6 is last market; devaluation happens at start of round 6 on cash: cash=floor/100*62!). Wait: start of round 2 and later cash devalues: cash*0.62. So cash earned in round 5 market would be devalued at round 6 start too. Round 5 market revenue already in cash 6581300. Actually promissory adds to cash at round start without devaluation.

So holding cash is bad. Produce → sell 2 in round 6 at ~6 and 5 alashi = 11 alashi, but devaluation applies? Devaluation at start of round 6, market after. So revenue earned at round 6 market is not devalued (no round 7). Good: produce then sell gives ~11 alashi. That's better than pass. Bribe to raise influence to 4 helps presidency and influence bonus 5% of bank (2 alashi). Bribe 5M costs 5 alashi, gain influence +1 — keeps presidency (already holder with 3 vs 2,2; likely fine). Keeping presidency matters for law round 6 (veto) — influence 3 vs rivals 2. Rivals could bribe though. Influence bonus 5% = 2 alashi; bribe cost 5 not worth unless presidency at risk. Choose produce.
